pydantic 2.9.2 migration root_validator validator model_validator ValidationInfo

rules.breaking_gotcha: SILENT SEMANTIC DRIFT: In mode='after', the argument is `self` (model instance), NOT a `values` dict. Accessing `values.get()` raises AttributeError unless converted to `self.field_name`.

rules.old_syntax:
@validator('fx_rate', always=True)
def check(cls, v, values: dict, field)
rules.breaking_gotcha: `values` dict and `field` argument are replaced by `info: ValidationInfo`. Use `info.data.get('field')` and `info.field_name`. Note `always=True` is replaced by `validate_default=True` on `Field`.
`__root__` attribute is renamed to `.root` via `RootModel[T]`. `each_item=True` is removed in v2; iterate over `v` inside `@field_validator('root')`.

rules.old_syntax:
from pydantic.generics import GenericModel
from pydantic import parse_obj_as
rules.new_syntax:
from pydantic import BaseModel, TypeAdapter
class Envelope(BaseModel, Generic[T]): ...
TypeAdapter(List[Envelope]).validate_python(raw_list)
rules.breaking_gotcha: `pydantic.generics.GenericModel` and `parse_obj_as` were removed. Inherit directly from `BaseModel, Generic[T]` and use `TypeAdapter(Type).validate_python(data)`.

rules.old_syntax: class Config: orm_mode = True; model.dict(); model.json(); Model.parse_obj(d); Field(regex=r'...')
rules.new_syntax: model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True); model.model_dump(); model.model_dump_json(); Model.model_validate(d); Field(pattern=r'...')
rules.breaking_gotcha: `min_items`/`max_items` on list `Field` must become `min_length`/`max_length`. `allow_mutation=False` becomes `frozen=True`. `allow_population_by_field_name=True` becomes `populate_by_name=True`.

rules.new_syntax: from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict; from openai import OpenAI; OpenAI().chat.completions.create(...)
rules.breaking_gotcha: `BaseSettings` lives in the separate `pydantic-settings` package in v2.
